images.description: The image displays a series of four diagrams, each illustrating the motion of an airplane with spinning wings, labeled "spin." These are technical drawings showing the trajectory of aircraft during different stages of flight: lift, spin, banked turn, and roll. The first drawing at the top left shows the plane rising straight up, indicating lift. As we move to the right, the next diagram demonstrates a spin, where the plane rotates on its vertical axis. In the third diagram, the airplane is shown in a banked turn, which involves leaning sideways to initiate and maintain the turn. The fourth diagram on the bottom right represents roll, where the plane's fuselage rotates along a horizontal axis. Each diagram uses arrows and color schemes to visually represent these different types of aircraft movement.
